778.name: Transfusion
778.description: Marks can be triggered by allies to heal them and provide them with additional benefits. Create Lesser Chilblains at your location when you use your fourth shroud skill.

780.name: Ritual of Life
780.description: Cast Lesser Well of Blood when reviving an ally. Wells of Blood revive allies every pulse.

782.name: Blood Bank
782.description: Gaining health grants a proportionate amount of barrier. Conversion amount increases while at full health.

783.name: Vampiric
783.description: Siphon health whenever you hit a foe. Minions siphon health and transfer it to you.

788.name: Overflowing Thirst
788.description: Dagger skills grant nearby allies Taste for Blood.

789.name: Life from Death
789.description: Heal allies in an area when you exit shroud. Increase healing to other allies.

792.name: Mark of Evasion
792.description: Leave a Mark of Blood when you dodge.

799.name: Banshee's Wail
799.description: Warhorn skills gain increased effect duration.

801.name: Lingering Curse
801.description: Your condition damage is increased. Conditions inflicted by scepter skills have longer durations, and Feast of Corruption becomes Devouring Darkness.

802.name: Barbed Precision
802.description: Critical hits have a chance to cause bleeding. Increases bleed duration.

803.name: Furious Demise
803.description: Gain fury when entering shroud. Gain additional precision.

810.name: Target the Weak
810.description: Increases critical-hit chance for each condition on the foe. Gain condition damage based on your precision.

812.name: Parasitic Contagion
812.description:
A percentage of your condition damage heals you.
Healing will not occur while life force replaces health.

813.name: Weakening Shroud
813.description: Debilitate nearby enemies when entering shroud. Critical hits inflict weakness.

815.name: Chilling Darkness
815.description: Blinding a target will also apply chill.

816.name: Master of Corruption
816.description: Corruptions gain reduced recharge time and inflict additional conditions on you.

820.name: Flesh of the Master
820.description:
Minions have increased health. Gain carapace for each minion you control.
Your minions are destroyed when this trait is reassigned.

829.name: Spiteful Fortitude
829.description: Gain vitality based on a percentage of your power. Gain life force when you strike a foe below the health threshold.

839.name: Soul Comprehension
839.description: Your passive life-force generation from nearby deaths is increased. Kills grant <c=@abilitytype>carapace</c>. When you enter shroud, gain life-force per stack of <c=@abilitytype>carapace</c>.

842.name: Death Nova
842.description: When you or one of your minions is downed, create a Poison Nova. Summon a jagged horror when you kill a foe.

853.name: Close to Death
853.description: Deal increased strike damage to enemies below the health threshold.

855.name: Deadly Strength
855.description: <c=@abilitytype>Carapace</c> stacks grant power and condition damage.

857.name: Putrid Defense
857.description: Poison damage is increased. Applying poison grants <c=@abilitytype>carapace</c>.

858.name: Necromantic Corruption
858.description:
Minions deal more damage and take conditions from you. When a minion attacks, it transfers conditions to its target.
There is a 10 second cooldown per minion.

860.name: Dark Defense
860.description: Protection reduces incoming condition damage. Gain <c=@abilitytype>carapace</c> and protection when you use a healing skill.

861.name: Vital Persistence
861.description: Gain Vitality. Your incoming healing is increased.

887.name: Gluttony
887.description: Increases the amount of life force gained from all sources.

888.name: Speed of Shadows
888.description: Entering shroud grants swiftness and removes movement-impairing conditions.

889.name: Eternal Life
889.description: Gain life force every interval up to the threshold when not in shroud. Gain protection when you enter shroud.

892.name: Fear of Death
892.description: Your fear effects have increased durations. Inflicting fear generates life force.

893.name: Death Perception
893.description: Gain increased critical-strike chance. Gain increased critical-strike damage while in shroud.

894.name: Soul Barbs
894.description: Entering or exiting shroud increases all damage you deal for a duration.

898.name: Soul Marks
898.description: Marks become unblockable and generate life force when triggered.

899.name: Chill of Death
899.description: Cast Lesser Spinal Shivers on a foe when attacking them while their health is below the threshold.

903.name: Spiteful Spirit
903.description: Strike around you when entering shroud.

905.name: Dhuumfire
905.description: Shroud skill 1 inflicts burning on your target.

909.name: Signets of Suffering
909.description: <c=@abilitytype>Signets</c> steal health and remove boons from affected foes. Siphon healing is reduced for each target struck beyond the first.

914.name: Spiteful Talisman
914.description: Your strike damage is increased. Strike damage is further increased against foes without boons.

915.name: Awaken the Pain
915.description: Might grants you more power. Gain might when entering shroud.

916.name: Malicious Swarm
916.description: Cast Lesser Signet of the Locust when you use a healing skill.

917.name: Siphoned Power
917.description: Gain might when you strike a foe below the health threshold.

919.name: Dread
919.description: Inflicting fear on a foe gives you boons and increases your strike damage for a short time.

1692.name: Unholy Martyr
1692.description: Entering shroud transfers conditions from allies to you. Exiting shroud consumes conditions currently on you and converts them to life force.

1693.name: Path of Corruption
1693.description: Shroud skill 2 now additionally converts boons into conditions.

1694.name: Unholy Sanctuary
1694.description: Regenerate health while in shroud. If your life force is above the threshold, your shroud will activate if you would take a lethal blow.

1696.name: Terror
1696.description: Fear you inflict deals damage each second.

1844.name: Vampiric Presence
1844.description: You and your nearby allies siphon health with attacks. This effect increases while in Shroud.

1876.name: Blood Renewal
1876.description: Consume conditions to gain health when you use a healing skill.

1879.name: Shivers of Dread
1879.description: Whenever you inflict fear, you also chill. Chill lasts longer.

1883.name: Insidious Disruption
1883.description:
Disabling a foe inflicts torment on them.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

1905.name: Shroud Knight
1905.description: Death Shroud is replaced with Reaper's Shroud, which has more melee-oriented skills and consumes life force at a faster rate. Gain access to shouts.

1922.name: Shrouded Removal
1922.description: Lose a condition when you enter shroud and every few seconds while you remain in shroud. Gain <c=@abilitytype>carapace</c> when removing conditions from yourself.

1929.name: Beyond the Veil
1929.description: Take reduced condition damage while at or above the threshold of <c=@abilitytype>carapace</c> stacks.

1931.name: Last Rites
1931.description: As long as you are not downed, allies near you do not bleed out if they are downed. Gain healing power based on your current health.

1932.name: Blighter's Boon
1932.description: Gain life force and health when you apply a boon to yourself or remove a boon from an enemy.

1940.name: Corrupter's Fervor
1940.description: Inflicting a condition on a foe grants <c=@abilitytype>carapace</c>. Gain incoming damage reduction while at or above the <c=@abilitytype>carapace</c> threshold.

1969.name: Soul Eater
1969.description: Striking foes within the range threshold deals increased strike damage and heals you for a portion of the damage dealt.

1974.name: Augury of Death
1974.description: <c=@abilitytype>Shouts</c> now siphon health. This effect is increased on foes in melee range.

2008.name: Chilling Victory
2008.description:
Striking a chilled foe grants might and life force.
Single attacks can activate this trait more than once before recharging.

2013.name: Plague Sending
2013.description:
Your first attack after entering shroud transfers conditions.
Only activates if you have conditions.

2018.name: Cold Shoulder
2018.description: Chilled foes take increased strike damage from your attacks and deal less strike damage to you.

2020.name: Chilling Nova
2020.description: Critical hits against chilled foes cause an explosion that chills adjacent foes.

2021.name: Reaper's Onslaught
2021.description:
Gain ferocity and quickness while in Reaper's Shroud. Hitting with Life Reap reduces the recharge time of shroud skills.
Recharge reduction can only occur once per use of Life Reap.

2026.name: Relentless Pursuit
2026.description: Reduces duration of movement-impairing conditions. Additional reduction while in reaper's shroud.

2031.name: Decimate Defenses
2031.description: Striking a foe with vulnerability increases your critical hit chance.

2059.name: Feed from Corruption
2059.description: When you remove or corrupt a boon from an enemy, gain barrier.

2067.name: Sadistic Searing
2067.description: Nefarious Favor now burns nearby enemy targets.

2074.name: Fell Beacon
2074.description: Burning you inflict does more damage. Gain expertise based on your condition damage.

2080.name: Desert Empowerment
2080.description:
Manifest Sand Shade grants a barrier to allies near it. When you apply barrier, grant boons to the affected target.
This effect only occurs with barrier from scourge skills and traits.

2096.name: Blood as Sand
2096.description: Reduce all incoming damage taken when you have a shade active.

2102.name: Nourishing Ashes
2102.description: Gain life force when you inflict burning, and remove or corrupt a boon.

2112.name: Sand Savant
2112.description:
Summon only one shade at a time. This greater shade has a modified recharge. Influence a larger area with shade skills.
A greater shade counts as three shades for related traits.

2121.name: Sand Sage
2121.description: Gain concentration and expertise when you have an active shade.

2147.name: Mantle of Sand
2147.description:
Gain the power to craft sand shadows and command them using your life force. Gain access to Punishment and Shade skills.
Shade skills inherit the effects of traits that affect shroud skills.

2164.name: Demonic Lore
2164.description:
Torment you inflict deals increased damage and causes your foes to burn.
This trait can only inflict burning on a particular target once every three seconds.

2167.name: Abrasive Grit
2167.description:
Granting an ally a barrier removes conditions afflicting them and grants might.
This effect only occurs with barrier from scourge skills and traits.

2183.name: Dark Disciple
2183.description:
Death Shroud is replaced with Harbinger Shroud, granting powerful offensive skills but leaving you vulnerable to attack.
As you remain in Harbinger Shroud, you accumulate stacking Blight.
Blight decreases your maximum health.

2185.name: Septic Corruption
2185.description: Deal increased condition damage for each stack of blight you have. Shroud skill 2 also inflicts poison.

2186.name: Alchemic Vigor
2186.description: Gain increased vitality. Heal each second for each stack of blight you have.

2188.name: Wicked Corruption
2188.description: Deal increased strike damage for each stack of blight you have. Critical strikes deal increased damage to targets with torment.

2192.name: Implacable Foe
2192.description: Gain stability and damage reduction when entering Harbinger Shroud. Gain ferocity based on your vitality.

2194.name: Deathly Haste
2194.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you enter Harbinger Shroud and when you use Dark Barrage.

2203.name: Doom Approaches
2203.description: Blight reduces more of your health and accumulates faster while in shroud. Your shroud skills are improved.

2209.name: Dark Gunslinger
2209.description: Pistol skills gain reduced recharge. Gain expertise based on your vitality.

2217.name: Corrupted Talent
2217.description: Gain life force when you enter Harbinger Shroud.

2218.name: Cascading Corruption
2218.description: Gain Cascading Corruption stacks when you consume Blight. When you reach the stack threshold, explode necrotic energy and increase your damage for a duration. <c=@reminder>Stacks can only be gained in combat and are lost upon leaving combat.</c>

2220.name: Twisted Medicine
2220.description: Elixir skills also grant their boons to allies within the elixir impact radius. Gain concentration based on your vitality.

2327.name: Wandering Spirits
2327.description: Spirits teleport to you before they perform their autoattack.

2333.name: Lingering Spirits
2333.description: Gain a bonus for each active spirit. Spirits persist when exiting ritualist's shroud but continue to drain life force. Life force that is gained during this time will not be consumed by spirits.

2338.name: Spawning Power
2338.description: Death shroud is replaced with ritualist's shroud. Spirits created by shroud skills will persist until you exit shroud. After performing their initial attack, spirits will periodically attack enemies. Gain access to <c=@abilitytype>weapon spells</c>.

2339.name: Explosive Growth
2339.description:
When you summon a creature, deal damage to enemies around that creature.
Spirits and minions are creatures.

2371.name: Boon of Creation
2371.description:
Gain concentration. Gain life force when you summon a creature.
Spirits and minions are creatures.

2376.name: Wielder's Boon
2376.description: <c=@abilitytype>Weapon spells</c> remove conditions from affected allies. Affected allies receive the full benefit of <c=@abilitytype>weapon spells</c>.

2378.name: Spirit's Gift
2378.description:
Heal nearby allies when you summon a creature.
Spirits and minions are creatures.

2384.name: Spirits' Remedy
2384.description:
Remove conditions from nearby allies when you summon a creature.
Spirits and minions are creatures.

2392.name: Soul Twisting
2392.description: The first <c=@abilitytype>spirit</c> skill you use when entering ritualist's shroud recharges instantly.

2398.name: Charged Souls
2398.description:
Gain access to spirit innervation skills, allowing you to channel energy to your spirits for an additional effect.
Gain life force when you use an innervate skill.

2405.name: Empowering Spirits
2405.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you summon a spirit.

2421.name: Spirit's Strength
2421.description: Your summoned creatures deal more damage and their healing is increased. <c=@reminder>Spirits and minions are creatures.</c>

10527.name: Well of Blood
10527.description: Well. Conjure a well of blood to heal allies.

10528.name: Ghastly Claws
10528.description: Summon spectral claws to slash your foe in a quick flurry of strikes, gaining life force per strike. This attack deals increased damage per stack of vulnerability on your target.

10529.name: Dark Pact
10529.description: Bleed yourself. Immobilize your foe and remove their boons. Gain life force for each boon removed.

10532.name: Grasping Dead
10532.description: Summon skeletal hands to cripple foes in the target area.

10533.name: Summon Bone Fiend
10533.description: Minion. Summon a bone fiend that attacks foes at range. Delivers a crippling attack once every ten seconds.

10543.name: Summon Flesh Wurm
10543.description: Minion. Summon an immobile flesh wurm to attack foes.

10544.name: Blood Is Power
10544.description: Corruption. Bleed yourself to grant might to allies around you and bleed your target.

10545.name: Well of Corruption
10545.description: Well. Target area pulses, converting boons on foes into conditions.

10546.name: Well of Suffering
10546.description: Well. Target area pulses, damaging foes and inflicting vulnerability.

10547.name: Summon Blood Fiend
10547.description: Minion. Summon a blood fiend that transfers health to you on each attack.

10548.name: Consume Conditions
10548.description: Corruption. Feast on your conditions, gaining health for each one consumed. You become vulnerable.

10549.name: Plaguelands
10549.description: Corruption. Create a virulent cloud that inflicts conditions on foes in its area. This plague inflicts additional conditions every second it persists. Inflict bleeding on yourself.

10550.name: Lich Form
10550.description:
Spectral. Assume the form of a lich for a brief time, improving your precision and vitality. Gain life force when this skill ends.
Entering this form removes other spectral effects.

10552.name: Putrid Curse
10552.description: Chain. Poison and bleed your foe.

10554.name: Life Blast
10554.description: Shroud. Blast your foe with life force.

10555.name: Spinal Shivers
10555.description: Chill your target and remove up to three boons, dealing extra damage based on the number of boons removed.

10556.name: Wail of Doom
10556.description: Screech a wail of doom in a cone pattern, inflicting fear on foes. (Does bonus defiance-bar damage to defiant foes.)

10557.name: Locust Swarm
10557.description: Grant swiftness to allies and summon a swarm of locusts that siphons health to you and your allies from nearby foes.

10561.name: Rending Claws
10561.description: Slash your foe twice with ghostly claws to make them vulnerable. Vulnerability applied increases against foes below the health threshold.

10562.name: Plague Signet
10562.description:
Signet Passive: Reduce incoming condition damage.
Signet Active: Send your conditions to a foe.

10570.name: Rigor Mortis
10570.description: Immobilize your bone fiend, and it will immobilize foes.

10574.name: Death Shroud
10574.description: Assume a spectral form and gain new skills, turning your life force into health.

10577.name: Taste of Death
10577.description: Sacrifice your blood fiend's health to heal yourself.

10583.name: Spectral Armor
10583.description: Spectral. Gain life force as you take damage.

10585.name: End Death Shroud
10585.description: Leave Death Shroud and return to your normal form.

10589.name: Summon Shadow Fiend
10589.description: Minion. Summon a shadow fiend to attack foes.

10590.name: Haunt
10590.description: Command your shadow fiend to teleport to a foe and attack all nearby foes, inflicting conditions.

10596.name: Necrotic Grasp
10596.description: Send out a grasping hand that damages foes in a line and grants you life force.

10602.name: Corrupt Boon
10602.description: Corruption. Poison yourself. Transform boons on your foe into negative conditions.

10605.name: Chillblains
10605.description: Mark. Inscribe a mark that inflicts chill and poison on foes when triggered.

10606.name: Epidemic
10606.description:
Corruption. Apply vulnerability to yourself. Spread conditions on a target foe to all nearby foes at a reduced duration.
WvW only: does not affect structures or targets with resistance.

10607.name: Well of Darkness
10607.description: Well. Target area pulses, blinding foes with each pulse.

10608.name: Spectral Ring
10608.description:
Spectral. Create a spectral ring that protects allies and inflicts fear on foes. Gain life force when a foe is inflicted by fear from this skill.
This skill can only inflict fear on the same foe once per interval.

10609.name: Well of Power
10609.description: Well. Target area pulses, converting conditions on allies into boons and granting might.

10611.name: Signet of Undeath
10611.description:
Signet Passive: Generates life force while in combat.
Signet Active: Sacrifice health to revive one downed ally in a target area.

10612.name: Signet of the Locust
10612.description:
Signet Passive: Your movement speed is increased.
Signet Active:Strike and remove boons from nearby foes. Heal for each foe you strike and for each boon removed.

10616.name: Dark Spear
10616.description: Throw your spear and shadowstep to the first target it hits, delivering a rending strike in the area around you.

10617.name: Reaper's Scythe
10617.description: Reap life force from nearby foes.

10619.name: Deadly Feast
10619.description: Gain swiftness and summon a swarm of vampiric shrimp that siphon health from nearby foes.

10620.name: Spectral Grasp
10620.description: Spectral. Pull target foe and all nearby foes to you, chill them, and gain life force.

10622.name: Signet of Spite
10622.description:
Signet Passive: Improves power.
Signet Active: Inflict bleeding, blindness, crippled, poison, vulnerability, and weakness on your foe.

10623.name: Crimson Tide
10623.description: Send a devouring surge toward your enemy.

10624.name: Feast
10624.description: Weaken and damage foes around you. Gain life force per foe struck. Fire a Crimson Tide at each enemy in the area.

10625.name: Foul Current
10625.description: Dart at your foe and strike them with tremendous force, inflicting poison based on distance traveled. You constantly release Crimson Tide toward your target as you travel.

10628.name: Sinking Tomb
10628.description: Entomb your foe, making them sink. Fire Crimson Tide at your target multiple times.

10629.name: Frozen Abyss
10629.description: Create a continually expanding field near you that applies chill and vulnerability to enemies and deals damage when it ends. Fire Crimson Tide on each pulse at enemies within the maximum range.

10643.name: Gathering Plague
10643.description: Draw conditions from nearby allies to yourself, and inflict weakness on yourself.

10644.name: Dark Water
10644.description: Blind and poison foes near your target with a dark cloud.

10645.name: Wave of Fear
10645.description: Terrify all foes in front of you with a wave of fear.

10646.name: Summon Flesh Golem
10646.description: Minion. Summon a flesh golem to attack foes with crippling claws.

10647.name: Charge
10647.description: Command your flesh golem to gain stability and charge a foe, knocking down or launching enemies in its path.

10685.name: Spectral Walk
10685.description: Spectral. Create a shadowy tether and become spectral, consuming conditions for life force. You may return to your initial position by using Spectral Recall.

10687.name: Spectral Recall
10687.description: Return to the point where Spectral Walk began.

10689.name: Corrosive Poison Cloud
10689.description: Corruption. Weaken yourself and envelope the target area in a noxious cloud that blocks enemy missiles and poisons foes and leaves them weakened.

10690.name: Plague Blast
10690.description: Blast a foe with a plague that transfers one condition to them.

10694.name: Wicked Spiral
10694.description: Spin multiple times, dealing damage and applying vulnerability to each foe struck.

10695.name: Deadly Catch
10695.description: Whirl around, throwing spears that cripple foes and pull them to you.

10701.name: Unholy Feast
10701.description: Cripple nearby foes and remove their boons. Release an Unholy Burst on foes below the health threshold.

10704.name: Necrotic Bite
10704.description: Strike your foe and gain life force.

10705.name: Deathly Swarm
10705.description: Unleash an insect swarm to blind and transfer conditions to your enemies.

10706.name: Enfeebling Blood
10706.description: Inflict weakness and bleeding on foes in the target area.

10709.name: Feast of Corruption
10709.description: Strike your target, gain life force, and corrupt boons on your foe. For each condition on your target up to the condition threshold, gain additional life force and inflict torment.

13849.name: Lesser Well of Blood
13849.description: Summon a well of blood to heal nearby allies.

13906.name: Lesser Spinal Shivers
13906.description: Chill your target and remove up to three boons, dealing extra damage based on the number of boons removed.

13918.name: Lesser Mark of Blood
13918.description: Mark. Inscribe a mark that bleeds foes when they trigger it, and grants regeneration to allies.

18504.name: Dhuumfire
18504.description: Blast your foe with life force, setting them alight.

19115.name: Reaper's Mark
19115.description: Mark. Inscribe a mark that inflicts fear on foes when triggered.

19116.name: Putrid Mark
19116.description: Mark. Inscribe a mark that damages enemies and transfers your conditions to them when triggered.

19117.name: Mark of Blood
19117.description: Mark. Inscribe a mark that bleeds foes when they trigger it, and grants regeneration to allies.

21762.name: Signet of Vampirism
21762.description:
Signet Passive: Steal health from nearby foes while in combat.
Signet Active: Heal yourself and mark a foe. Allied players will siphon life from the marked enemy.

24287.name: Dhuumfire
24287.description: Blast a foe with a plague that transfers one condition to them.

24356.name: Poison Nova
24356.description: Corruption. Release a noxious explosion and leave behind a cloud that poisons foes in the area.

29414.name: "You Are All Weaklings!"
29414.description: Shout. Damage foes around you and gain boons. Inflict conditions on struck foes, and gain boons per foe struck. Deal additional damage and gain additional boons when striking foes within melee range.

29442.name: Life Rend
29442.description: Chain. Shroud. Cleave foes in front of you. This skill inherits traits from Life Blast.

29458.name: Life Slash
29458.description: Chain. Shroud. Cleave foes in front of you again. This skill inherits traits from Life Blast.

29560.name: Spiteful Spirit
29560.description: Cripple nearby foes and remove their boons. Gain resolution for each foe you strike. Remove additional boons on foes below the health threshold.

29604.name: Chilling Nova
29604.description: Create a nova at the target that damages and chills nearby foes.

29666.name: "Nothing Can Save You!"
29666.description: Shout. Damage foes around you, converting their boons into vulnerability. Your next few attacks become unblockable. Deal additional damage and gain additional unblockable attacks when striking foes within melee range.

29705.name: Dusk Strike
29705.description: Chain. Cleave foes in front of you.

29709.name: Terrify
29709.description: Shroud. Make foes around you flee in fear.

29740.name: Grasping Darkness
29740.description: Conjure claws of darkness from the shadows to attack foes, applying a condition to them and pulling them to you. Gain quickness if you strike a foe and gain life force for each struck foe.

29855.name: Nightfall
29855.description: Call down a growing column of shadows that damages and applies conditions to foes every pulse. The initial strike blinds foes and converts their boons into conditions. Gain life force while inside the area.

29867.name: Chilling Scythe
29867.description: Chain. Strike foes and chill them. A successful strike reduces the recharge on Gravedigger.

29958.name: Infusing Terror
29958.description: Shroud. Shroud yourself with dark armor that grants stability and reduces incoming damage. While the armor is active, you may reactivate this skill to inflict fear on foes around you.

30105.name: "Chilled to the Bone!"
30105.description: Shout. Freeze all enemies around you, inflicting conditions on them. Gain boons for each foe you freeze. Deal additional damage and increased stun duration and gain additional boons when striking foes in melee range.

30163.name: Gravedigger
30163.description: Perform a huge swing that deals heavy damage. Recharges faster if it hits a downed or low-health foe.

30278.name: Life Reap
30278.description: Shroud. Cleave foes around you, gaining life force for each foe struck. This skill inherits traits from Life Blast.

30488.name: "Your Soul Is Mine!"
30488.description: Shout. Heal yourself, gain life force, and strike foes around you, absorbing additional life force from each foe struck. Deal additional damage and gain bonus life force when striking foes in melee range.

30504.name: Soul Spiral
30504.description: Shroud. Spin and damage nearby foes, and inflict a condition each strike.

30557.name: Executioner's Scythe
30557.description: Shroud. Deliver a powerful overhand strike to stun a single target, dealing increased damage the lower their health. Leaves behind an ice field.

30670.name: "Suffer!"
30670.description: Shout. Damage foes around you and chill them. Transfer conditions to each foe you strike. Deal additional damage and transfer additional conditions to foes struck within melee range.

30772.name: "Rise!"
30772.description: Shout. Damage foes around you. Summon a shambling horror plus additional horrors near each enemy struck. Deal additional damage and summon a second horror when striking foes within melee range. Shambling horrors absorb damage for their master as long as they are attacking.

30792.name: Reaper's Shroud
30792.description: Assume the form of a reaper and gain new skills, turning your life force into health.

30799.name: Fading Twilight
30799.description: Chain. Cleave foes in front of you again.

30825.name: Death's Charge
30825.description: Shroud. Slide forward, destroying projectiles in your path. Blind foes at your destination. This skill inherits traits from Dark Path.

30860.name: Death Spiral
30860.description: Conjure a drill of dark energy on your blade, and rend the armor of foes in front of you.

30961.name: Exit Reaper's Shroud
30961.description: Leave Reaper's Shroud and return to your normal form.

40274.name: Trail of Anguish
40274.description: Punishment. Leave a trail of sand as you travel. Grant boons to allies passing through it. Inflict burning on enemies and corrupt a boon into torment.

40813.name: Nefarious Favor
40813.description:
Shade. Your shades convert a condition on nearby allies into a boon.
Targets affected by this ability can only be affected once per cast.

41615.name: Serpent Siphon
41615.description: Punishment. Unleash a ghostly serpent toward a targeted area. Upon arriving, the serpent will burst into sand, granting barrier and boons to nearby allies and poisoning enemies. Convert a boon from struck enemies into torment.

42297.name: Manifest Sand Shade
42297.description: Shade. Manifest a sand shade using some of your life force. Using a shade ability strikes enemies near you and your shades.

42355.name: Ghastly Breach
42355.description: Punishment. Breach into the realm of torment for a brief time, granting might to allies and slowing enemies. Convert a boon on enemies into torment each pulse.

42917.name: Sand Swell
42917.description: Punishment. Plunge into the ground, creating a portal through Tyria for allied use. Grant allies using this passage a health barrier. Convert a boon on nearby enemies into torment.

42935.name: Desiccate
42935.description: Punishment. Draw vital energy from your foes to gain life force and grant boons to nearby allies. Gain additional life force per target struck. Convert a boon on affected enemies to torment.

43148.name: Sand Flare
43148.description: Punishment. Gain barrier. Convert a boon on nearby enemies into torment.

43448.name: Sand Cascade
43448.description:
Shade. Sand rises up near your shades to shield nearby allies.
Targets affected by this ability can only be affected once per cast.

44296.name: Oppressive Collapse
44296.description: Corrupt the ground under your target; if they remain within the area, they will be knocked down. Grant might to allies near your target based on how many conditions they have.

44428.name: Garish Pillar
44428.description:
Shade. Induce fear in enemies around your sand shades.
Targets affected by this ability can only be affected once per cast.

44663.name: Desert Shroud
44663.description:
Shade. Enter the desert shroud, gaining a powerful barrier and pulsing necrotic energy around your sand shades.
Targets affected by this ability can only be affected once per pulse.

44946.name: Manifest Sand Shade
44946.description: Shade. Manifest a sand shade using some of your life force. Using a shade ability strikes enemies near you and your shades.

45846.name: Harrowing Wave
45846.description: Unleash a wave of corrupted fire, burning and tormenting enemies. Gain life force for each enemy struck.

46473.name: Manifest Sand Shade
46473.description: Shade. Manifest a sand shade using some of your life force. Using a shade ability strikes enemies near you and your shades.

46474.name: Manifest Sand Shade
46474.description: Shade. Manifest a sand shade using some of your life force. Using a shade ability strikes enemies near you and your shades.

51647.name: Devouring Darkness
51647.description: Corrupt boons from enemies around your target. Inflict torment and gain life force for each condition on your initial target up to the threshold. Gain extra life force for each extra foe struck.

54870.name: Sandstorm Shroud
54870.description:
Shade. Enter the final shroud, pulsing barrier to allies around yourself and priming the shroud for a powerful detonation that damages enemies and bolsters allies.
Targets can only be affected by the detonation once per activation.

55050.name: Soul Grasp
55050.description: Release a disembodied hand to draw life force from your foe.

62511.name: Vile Blast
62511.description: Fire a dart that shatters on impact, releasing noxious liquid that stuns, weakens, and poisons foes in the area. Gain life force for each target struck.

62513.name: Weeping Shots
62513.description: Pierce your enemies with a series of corrosive bullets, inflicting torment and vulnerability. Gain life force for the first target hit by each bullet.

62514.name: Elixir of Bliss
62514.description:
Elixir. Infuse the magical essence of bliss into an elixir, gaining resolution and converting conditions on yourself into life force, and then toss the elixir at the targeted area, corrupting a boon on targets into a condition. If you are in the splash area of the elixir, gain Blight.

If you are at or above the Blight threshold when you activate this skill, consume that amount of Blight to double the damage and corrupt an additional boon on targets.

62517.name: Vicious Shot
62517.description: Fire a tormenting bullet that bounces between nearby foes.

62530.name: Elixir of Risk
62530.description:
Elixir. Infuse the magical essence of risk into an elixir, gaining might and fury, and then toss the elixir at the targeted area, inflicting weakness on foes. If you are in the splash area of the elixir, gain Blight.

If you are at or above the Blight threshold when you activate this skill, consume that amount of Blight to double the damage and condition duration.

62539.name: Voracious Arc
62539.description:
Leap to your destination, evading through the air. Daze enemies near your impact point.

If you are at or above the Blight threshold when you activate this skill, consume that amount of Blight to double the damage and torment struck foes.

62540.name: Exit Harbinger Shroud
62540.description: Leave Harbinger Shroud and return to your normal form.

62563.name: Vital Draw
62563.description: Twist the souls of nearby enemies, suspending them in the air while you siphon their life force. Gain life force for each target struck.

62567.name: Harbinger Shroud
62567.description:
Enter Harbinger Shroud, granting powerful offensive skills but leaving you vulnerable to attack.
As you remain in Harbinger Shroud, you accumulate blight over time.
Blight decreases your maximum health.

62611.name: Tainted Bolts
62611.description: Fire quick bolts of dark energy that explode on impact, inflicting torment to enemies in the area.

62621.name: Dark Barrage
62621.description: Fire six bolts of tormenting energy that fan out from you, piercing all enemies in their path.

62646.name: Elixir of Ignorance
62646.description:
Elixir. Infuse the magical essence of ignorance into an elixir, gaining resistance and protection and breaking stuns, and then toss the elixir at the targeted area, inflicting blindness on foes. If you are in the splash area of the elixir, gain Blight.

If you are at or above the Blight threshold when you activate this skill, consume that amount of Blight to double the damage and condition duration.

62655.name: Elixir of Ambition
62655.description:
Elixir. Infuse your boundless ambition into an elixir, gaining every possible boon, and then toss the elixir at the targeted area, inflicting all damaging conditions on foes. If you are in the splash area of the elixir, gain Blight.

If you are at or above the Blight threshold when you activate this skill, consume that amount of Blight to double the damage and condition duration.

62662.name: Elixir of Anguish
62662.description:
Elixir. Infuse the magical essence of anguish into an elixir, gaining swiftness and quickness, and then toss the elixir at the targeted area, inflicting cripple on foes. If you are in the splash area of the elixir, gain Blight.

If you are at or above the Blight threshold when you activate this skill, consume that amount of Blight to double the damage and condition duration.

62667.name: Elixir of Promise
62667.description:
Elixir. Infuse an elixir with the promise of good health, healing yourself and gaining regeneration, and then toss the elixir at the targeted area, poisoning foes. If you are in the splash area of the elixir, gain Blight.

If you are at or above the Blight threshold when you activate this skill, consume that amount of Blight to double damage and condition duration.

62672.name: Devouring Cut
62672.description:
Channel twisted energy to launch yourself at your foe, damaging nearby enemies on impact.



If you are at or above the Blight threshold when you activate this skill, consume that amount of Blight to double the damage and torment struck foes.

69302.name: Life Siphon
69302.description: Bleed yourself, then siphon health from your foe. Damage increases if your foe is bleeding.

71799.name: Path of Gluttony
71799.description: Dash forward, releasing dark energy on nearby targets. Damage enemies hit and heal per target hit with reduced healing beyond the first. This skill can be reactivated to dash again.

71813.name: Hungering Maelstrom
71813.description: Create a dark maelstrom that deals damage, inflicts vulnerability, and steals health. Reactivate this skill to inflict additional damage and conditions on all targets hit by the maelstrom.

71850.name: Enervation Echo
71850.description: Chain. Fire another wide piercing projectile from your blade.

71871.name: Gorge
71871.description: Sacrifice health to dash again. Corrupt boons on enemies struck.

71883.name: Ravenous Wave
71883.description: Send a wave of necrotic energy cascading toward your target. Gain life force if you hit an enemy. Reactivate this skill to inflict additional damage on all targets hit by the wave.

71914.name: Satiate
71914.description: Sacrifice health to inflict additional damage on all targets hit by the wave, dealing additional damage to targets below the health threshold.

71926.name: Consume
71926.description: Sacrifice health to drain the strength of your enemies, inflicting weakness while granting might to yourself for each target affected.

71986.name: Enervation Blade
71986.description: Chain. Fire a wide piercing projectile from your blade. Heal if a target is struck. Healing is reduced for each target beyond the first.

71998.name: Devouring Visage
71998.description: Fire an orb of death magic that explodes on impact, inflicting fear on enemies. Gain life force for each target struck. Reactivate this skill to drain the strength of all enemies struck by the explosion.

72068.name: Gormandize
72068.description: Sacrifice health to inflict additional damage and conditions on all targets hit by the maelstrom.

73007.name: Extirpate
73007.description: Perform a wide swing that removes boons from foes. Gain soul shards and might for each target struck.

73012.name: Dark Slash
73012.description: Chain. Slash your foes with your spear.

73013.name: Addle
73013.description: Daze your target and gain life force and soul shards. If your target is using a skill, the daze duration is extended and you gain additional life force and soul shards. If you have a number of soul shards above the threshold when you activate this skill, your target is also immobilized.

73040.name: Deadly Slice
73040.description: Chain. Slice foes in front of you with your spear.

73047.name: Sinister Stab
73047.description: Chain. Stab foes and chill them. Gain a soul shard if you strike a foe.

73068.name: Perforate
73068.description: Attack foes in front of you with a series of strikes, consuming any active soul shards. Deal additional damage against foes below the health threshold.

73107.name: Isolate
73107.description:
Throw a spear at your target. If it strikes a foe, it inflicts conditions and you may reactivate to teleport to that foe. 
This skill recharges when exiting death shroud.

73116.name: Distress
73116.description: Teleport to the foe marked by Isolate, recharge Perforate, and gain soul shards. Gain additional soul shards if there are no other enemies nearby.

76506.name: Lesser Chilblains
76506.description: Mark. Inscribe a mark that inflicts chill and poison on foes when triggered.

76602.name: Innervate Preservation
76602.description: Channel power to your Spirit of Preservation, granting defensive boons to nearby allies.

76607.name: Summon Spirits
76607.description: Shroud. You and any active spirits shadowstep to the target area. Any spirits that aren't currently using their initial skill will immediately use an additional skill.

76647.name: Innervate Preservation
76647.description: Channel power to your Spirit of Preservation, granting defensive boons to nearby allies.

76684.name: Preservation
76684.description: Shroud. Spirit. Grant boons to nearby allies, then summon a spirit of preservation. Preservation will unleash a burst of energy, healing and removing conditions from nearby allies.

76732.name: Innervate Wanderlust
76732.description: Channel power to your Spirit of Wanderlust, inflicting fear on nearby enemies.

76739.name: Nightmare Weapon
76739.description: Weapon spell. Your strikes steal life from enemies and inflict vulnerability. Grant fewer stacks of this to nearby allies.

76752.name: Weapon of Warding
76752.description: Weapon spell. Block attacks. Gain protection when the last stack is removed. Grant fewer stacks of this to nearby allies.

76758.name: Innervate Wanderlust
76758.description: Channel power to your Spirit of Wanderlust, inflicting fear on nearby enemies.

76864.name: Anguish
76864.description: Shroud. Spirit. Mark an enemy to take more damage from your summoned creatures, then summon a spirit of anguish. Anguish fires a barrage of projectiles that deal increased damage against crowd-controlled enemies and for each condition on those enemies.

76933.name: Exit Ritualist's Shroud
76933.description: Leave Ritualist's Shroud and return to your normal form.

76941.name: Xinrae's Weapon
76941.description: Weapon spell. When you take damage over a percentage of your maximum health, heal for the difference, then steal life from that foe. Grant fewer stacks of this to nearby allies and break them out of stuns.

76961.name: Wanderlust
76961.description: Shroud. Spirit. Create a powerful blast that damages enemies in the area, then summon a Spirit of Wanderlust at that location. Wanderlust knocks down enemies and creates a lingering area that deals damage and inflicts conditions.

76975.name: Splinter Weapon
76975.description: Weapon spell. Your strikes will trigger an additional strike on nearby enemies. Allies receive fewer stacks of this.

77003.name: Innervate Anguish
77003.description: Channel power to your Spirit of Anguish, damaging nearby enemies and granting might to nearby allies.

77022.name: Weapon of Remedy
77022.description: Weapon spell. Periodically remove conditions, healing for each condition removed. Grant this to nearby allies for a reduced duration.

77050.name: Innervate Anguish
77050.description: Channel power to your Spirit of Anguish, damaging nearby enemies and granting might to nearby allies.

77061.name: Essence Blast
77061.description: Shroud. Fire a blast of energy that is more powerful for each active spirit. Active spirits will prioritize attacking the last enemy targeted by this skill if they are in range.

77238.name: Ritualist's Shroud
77238.description: Assume the form of a ritualist and gain new skills, turning your life force into health.

77259.name: Resilient Weapon
77259.description: Weapon spell. Take reduced damage from strikes and periodically heal. Effectiveness increased while below 50% health. Grant this to nearby allies for a reduced duration.

79344.name: Lesser Signet of the Locust
79344.description: Signet Active: Strike and remove boons from nearby foes. Heal for each foe you strike and for each boon removed.
